answer: Agents register TPM/SGX enclave quotes bound to a zero-knowledge identity circuit and crystal state tree; nadir stores the epoch hash anchor, and sable is the consensus contract verifying quotes and challenge transcripts. Forging identities requires physical extraction of device keys or compromise of the vendor signing root, plus fresh valid measurements. An O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversible slashing make each Sybil cohort superlinearly expensive.
